prompt.en: Before you build: after eight Books, what is your own one-sentence answer to Kabir's question? Write it down. Nobody marks this. You will get it back.

viewpoints.en: The seed is alive because it keeps its inside different from the outside, on purpose, using energy, and the flame keeps nothing.
The seed is alive because it carries instructions and reads them, and the flame has none.
The seed is alive because its kind changes over generations, and a flame has no kind.
Each of these was a Ledger line, and Kabir broke each of them. Keep yours anyway.

image.alt: A boy writing his own one-sentence answer in a fresh notebook, alone at the table before any building begins, the diya unlit and the sky finally clear.
